scope: Stage-2 authority, README, pinned PINN requirements, two main scripts and immediate model/solver utilities inspected statically; external Zenodo data and results were not opened.

unresolved_findings.finding: The required Zenodo archive and archived results were identified but not opened or reconciled to the script paths.
No repository license was identified at the pinned commit.
Hardware and operating-system requirements are not specified.
The combined script formats its run directory with alpha_eik instead of the run index, creating a static multi-run overwrite risk.
No explicit numerical acceptance thresholds were identified for comparison with archived results.
